Hey Tom,

Hope you're doing well! Just wanted to let you know that we've posted all the details for the Security Awareness Training RFP on our supplier portal. It's open for you to review now. Could you please register on the portal at https://suppliers.auriga-retail.com/register? It only takes a couple of minutes and gives you access to everything you need. Let me know if you have any questions!

Best,
Markus

events.reply: Hi Markus, thanks, that sounds interesting. I've had a first look at the portal. Two quick questions: who on your side is the main contact for questions on the RFP, and what is the deadline for proposals? Also, is there a briefing or Q&A round planned? I'll take a closer look this week.

body:
Hi Tom,

Great to hear you took a look! Our main contact for any RFP questions is me, Markus. The proposal deadline is set for December 12th. We don’t have a separate briefing, but you can submit any questions through the Q&A module on the supplier portal—everyone will see the responses there. Feel free to register and dive deeper into the RFP details!

Best,
Markus

events.reply: Hi Markus, thanks, that helps. The scope with 4,200 employees and the SMS/WhatsApp reach for store staff fits what we do well. I'll register on the portal and go through the RFP in detail on Monday or Tuesday, and send any questions through the Q&A module. Best, Tom
